meta.rule: Only promotions printed on the bank's own pages are listed. 'no-offer-displayed' means the official product page fetched on 2026-10-21/22 showed no opening cash bonus and no promotional APY — it does not prove that no targeted or mailer offer exists.

promotions.requirement: Be a new Barclays Tiered Savings customer (current or previous Barclays savings/CD customers are ineligible); open by 10/31/2026; fund the new account with at least $25,000 within the first 30 days; keep at least $25,000 for 120 consecutive days. Bonus posts about 60 days after the 120-day period and is reported on Form 1099-INT as interest.
promotions.value_note: $200 on a $25,000 deposit equals 0.80% of principal, one time — on top of the APY earned during the 120 days.
